detailed_descriptions.en: Galactic conflict has left thousands of wrecks drifting across the system, and each one holds a fortune in raw ore. The Orbitron Corporation is the galaxy’s cleanup service, and you’re its newest cleanup unit. Your job: break each wreck down and haul it home. SUNNY, the company’s cheerful PR bot, will be with you every step of the way. Just don’t ask where all these wrecks keep coming from. Then spend hours in Overtime Mode: a variety of bigger one-shot contracts where you can experience the full progression path in one structure. Play it straight up to earn stars, or take advantage of your Executive Privileges and go wild. Best played after the campaign, but not required. detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Galactic conflict has left thousands of wrecks drifting across the system, and each one holds a fortune in raw ore. The Orbitron Corporation is the galaxy’s cleanup service, and you’re its newest cleanup unit. Your job: break each wreck down and haul it home. SUNNY, the company’s cheerful PR bot, will be with you every step of the way. Just don’t ask where all these wrecks keep coming from.

Then spend hours in Overtime Mode: a variety of bigger one-shot contracts where you can experience the full progression path in one structure. Play it straight up to earn stars, or take advantage of your Executive Privileges and go wild. Best played after the campaign, but not required.

Features


  • Build your own ship and mine a variety of wrecked ships and megastructures
  • Cash in your haul to upgrade and modify your ship
  • Squeeze every bit of value from your ore in the Extractor
  • Research mods that change how your weapons work
  • Discover ancient relics with powerful abilities
  • Full controller support
